name: S'mores Draft Latte
summary: Limited-edition S'mores Draft Latte: espresso roast on whole milk with Dutch cocoa and cane sugar, nitrogen-frothed in the same 11 oz can as the Vanilla and Pumpkin Spice. 190 mg of caffeine and 7 g of protein, with 20 g of sugar (11 g of it added) at 190 calories. Lactase is in the ingredients, but unlike the Caramel, Vanilla and Pumpkin Spice cans this one prints no lactose-free badge on the front.
tastingNotes: I had one sip of this and said wow out loud, which does not usually happen with a canned latte. It's smooth and creamy, and then the espresso shows up like it has somewhere to be. Most flavored cans bury the coffee under the flavor. This one leads with the coffee and lets the s'mores part, the cocoa and that toasted marshmallow sweetness, come in behind it. I poured mine over ice, and it came out with cocoa dusted across the top of the foam. I did not do that. It comes out of the can that way. And there's no aftertaste. The Pumpkin Spice Latte left something hanging around that I couldn't place, but this one finishes clean. So naturally my next thought was whether I could drink this every day. The caffeine isn't the problem. 190 mg is under half of what the FDA considers fine for a healthy adult. The sugar is the problem. This can has 20 g of sugar, 11 g of it added, at 190 calories, and 11 g of added sugar is close to half of what the American Heart Association suggests a woman get in an entire day. That's before you've eaten anything. So no, not daily. A couple of times a week, in the afternoon, when you want dessert and coffee in the same can.
